mathematical_anchors.name: NEON_Popcount_PowerOfTwo_Hash_Bucket_Index
mathematical_anchors.proof: At 0x022a68..0x022a9c and 0x0374b8..0x0374ec, bucket_count B is moved to a 64-bit NEON vector (`fmov d0, x8`), byte popcounted (`cnt v0.8b, v0.8b; uaddlv h0, v0.8b; fmov w10, s0`), and compared (`cmp w10, #1; b.hi`). Power-of-two sizes execute `sub x10, x8, #1; and x8, x9, x10`; non-power-of-two sizes execute `udiv x10, x9, x8; msub x8, x10, x8, x9`.

mathematical_anchors.name: NEON_Vectorized_TaskQueue_Cursor_Update_and_0x400_Compaction
mathematical_anchors.proof: At 0x01e0f0 and 0x01e444, `.rodata` `0x00d860` (`01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff`) is loaded into `q0` (`ldr q0, [x8, #0x860]`), added to `{front_idx, size}` via `add v0.2d, v1.2d, v0.2d`, stored back via `str q0, [x19, #0x40]`, and checked against `0x400` (`cmp x8, #0x400; b.lo`) before calling `memmove` to compact the ring buffer.
